lineNumberConvention: Original zero-based Inspector line/column values; no source location invented.
accounting: Leaf sample counts partition selected samples. Inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed. Interval intersections are timestamp bookkeeping, not attributed CPU time.
limitations: Qualitative isolate stack samples only; no CPU shares or speed claim.
All process threads, physical RTx, native core versus NAPI snapshot cost are not resolved.
Native shared invoke may be named close under resume; this is not actual close cost.
